_instructions: Optional owner-supplied recipe photographs. Add keys by recipe ID (recommended) or exact title. Each entry uses url, credit, license, source. URLs must be HTTPS. Example: "my-recipe-id": {"url":"https://example.com/pie.jpg","credit":"Photographer Name","license":"Used with permission","source":"https://example.com/photo-page"}. The site otherwise finds matching licensed images from Wikimedia Commons without any API key.
